title: refactor(helpers): extract duplicated setFormDataHeaders into a shared helper
description: ## Summary `lib/helpers/resolveConfig.js` and `lib/adapters/http.js` each carry their own copy of `setFormDataHeaders` (plus the `FORM_DATA_CONTENT_HEADERS` list). The two copies are identical except that the `resolveConfig.js` one guards against a missing headers object (`formHeaders || {}`). This PR moves the function to `lib/helpers/setFormDataHeaders.js` (one helper per file, matching the rest of `lib/helpers`) and imports it from both call sites, keeping the defensive variant — so the http adapter now also tolerates a FormData implementation whose `getHeaders()` returns `undefined`. No other behavior change: both call sites already invoke it with the same `(headers, data.getHeaders(), formDataHeaderPolicy)` shape. ## Testing - `npm run lint` clean - `vitest run --project unit`: 946 passed — including all 89 form-data-related tests that exercise both touched call paths. (The two failures on my machine — `fetch failed error as an AxiosError with ERR_NETWORK` and the DNS `should handle errors` case — fail identically on an unmodified checkout; they are environment/DNS-dependent, not related to this change.) *Found with an automated near-duplicate-helper detector I'm building ([QodeX](https://github.com/QodeXcli/QodeX)); the consolidation itself was reviewed and applied by hand.* --- ## Summary by cubic Centralized FormData header handling by extracting `setFormDataHeaders` into `lib/core/setFormDataHeaders.js` and using it in both `resolveConfig` and the Node HTTP adapter. Behavior is unchanged; the adapter now also tolerates `FormData#getHeaders()` returning `undefined` when `formDataHeaderPolicy: 'content-only'`. **Description** - Summary of changes - Added `lib/core/setFormDataHeaders.js` and imported it in `lib/helpers/resolveConfig.js` and `lib/adapters/http.js`. - Preserved `content-only` policy behavior and the guard for missing `formHeaders`. - Reasoning - Removed duplicate logic and kept axios-specific behavior in `core` rather than expanding generic helpers. - Additional context - Both call sites already call it as `(headers, data.getHeaders(), formDataHeaderPolicy)`. Pre-release changelog notes the Node robustness fix. **Docs** - No user-facing changes. Optionally add a short note in `/docs/form-data.md` confirming both environments honor `formDataHeaderPolicy` and tolerate missing form-data headers. **Testing** - Added a Node HTTP regression test to ignore `undefined` `getHeaders()` results with `content-only` policy. - Existing unit tests continue to cover both paths. **Semantic version impact** - Patch: internal refactor with no API changes; minor robustness improvement only. Written for commit 14c01a022d3d8121572034cfe4634135c07d6672. Summary will update on new commits.
